text:
alex k: Quick ping — found a gap in token attribution for 2024-05-11 00:00-03:00 UTC. Looking for owners and immediate triage. gap shows ~8% missing tokens compared to logs :thinking:

rachel p: Which dataset? billing or realtime-ingest?

alex k: billing events. Query shows fewer attributed tokens after the rollout. Sample query:
```sql
SELECT event_ts, count_tokens FROM billing_events
WHERE event_ts >= '2024-05-11T00:00:00Z' AND event_ts < '2024-05-11T03:00:00Z'
GROUP BY event_ts;
```

samir: I can take initial triage. I'll compare kafka offsets vs billing ingestion. tagging @maya for schema checks

maya: on it. any schema changes in last deploy?

alex k: devex rolled a tiny rename (`token_count` -> `tokens`) in ingestion v3 at ~23:59 UTC. rollout note: https://redwood.internal/rollouts/ingest-v3 :warning:

rachel p: ah. That would drop attributes if mapping missing. billing-ops, any fallback?

billing-ops: We have a fallback that maps both fields but it's only enabled in dedicated accounts. I'll check if the mapping service was active for hosted tier.

telemetry-bot: Alert created: token-attrib-gap-1715004321, severity=medium

samir: initial diff: consumer lag spiked but not full outage. I'll push a hotfix mapping to bridge fields and run a reingest for the window. PR @samir -> pinging @rachel for review.

rachel p: reviewing now, pls attach logs of mapping failures

samir: attaching snippet:
```
ERROR 2024-05-11T00:12:03Z mapping_missing tokens
```

maya: schema patch LGTM, no backward incompatible change. once mapping deployed we should see counts backfill.

billing-ops: mapping service was down for 6m due to config rollout, re-enabled at 00:06 UTC. Backfill queued.

alex k: milestone: hotfix deploy + backfill started. owners: triage=Samir, schema=Maya, billing ops=Billing-ops, review=Rachel. ETA for backfill complete ~2h. Will update.

rachel p: can you post the PR link when ready? also add a note in the instrumentation board.

alex k: PR -> https://git.redwood/pulls/4501. added note on board.

samir: backfill started at 1715005000, tracking progress.

alex k: thx all :thumbsup:
